decisions.reason: The request to email a draft copyright certificate for wording review does not change the selected logo design or any visual-design attribute.
Review of the separate copyright certificate is not an additional logo concept or revision and does not alter the completed logo revision process.
Emailing a draft legal certificate does not change the required logo asset formats, usability, or delivery coverage.
The certificate wording review is unrelated to font identification, complementary font recommendations, or brand typography guidance.
The copyright-certificate review process does not change the required background-box or colour variants of the final logo.
